first_reader_check.about: Whether a published tag on a released mathematics item is required to match the key, tested by programs that lack the tagged operation.
first_reader_check.shown: Three Holm families, never mixed. Catalog 105 tests, 0 Holm, two per-cell existence rows (Regents geometry 0.323 n=279; EQAO grade 6 0.500 n=40, index-specific). Strategy 67: STAAR grade-5 arithmetic closure 21/40 is the only Holm reject and failed powered replication (combined 21/64=0.328, CI covers chance). LM 68: withheld-quantity letter-argmax reader in Qwen2.5 and Phi-4 on Algebra I/II; Phi-4 geometry unclaimed (non-modal-key 0.229 n=118); Mistral does not clear; human 15/40 is an uninformative null. TIMSS knowing/applying/reasoning remain null at selected-response n about 50 to 80 (clustered floors 0.415/0.426/0.441).
first_reader_check.what_is_new: A three-family requirement census on tagged public mathematics: withheld-quantity increment on the choices-only construction, publisher tags, Holm within family, TIMSS cells, and a strategy discovery that does not replicate.
first_reader_check.why_a_big_deal: On catalog-matched items a pass does not require the tagged operation. On Algebra I and Algebra II masked-stem hits a pass does not require the givens. Public TIMSS items in this search did not yield either kind of program.
